bio.text: Mike Hilgers is Nebraska's 33rd Attorney General.
Before taking office he spent six years in the Nebraska Legislature representing District 21 in northwest Lincoln and Lancaster County, serving his last two years as Speaker.

He practiced law for more than fifteen years, clerked for Judge Edith Clement of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, founded his own litigation firm, and graduated from the University of Chicago Law School.
